name: limabean
description: Shows Claude and you which limabean VM it's in and what that VM may reach; on the Mac, a pane of your VMs.

limabean.title: limabean binary
limabean.description: Path to limabean on the Mac, if it isn't on the PATH Claude Code starts with (e.g. /opt/homebrew/bin/limabean). Empty: look in the usual places.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: Show sample data instead of real VMs, to see what the mod looks like: mac (the pane and status line) or vm (inside a VM).
